The ''{{ill|Shinsen Shōjiroku|de|Shinsen Shōjiroku|fr|Shinsen shōjiroku|ja|新撰姓氏録|ko|신찬성씨록|ru|Синсэн сёдзироку|zh|新撰姓氏錄|qid=Q1045362|lt=Shinsen Shōjiroku}}'' compiled during the {{ill|Heian period|ar|فترة هييآن|ast|Periodu Heian|az|Heyan dövrü|bcl|Panahon ni Heian|bg|Хеян|bn|হেইআন যুগ|br|Marevezh Heian|ca|Període Heian|ceb|Panahon sa Heian|cs|Období Heian|de|Heian-Zeit|el|Περίοδος Χεϊάν|eo|Epoko Heian|es|Período Heian|eu|Heian aroa|fa|دوره هی‌آن|fi|Heian-kausi|fr|Époque de Heian|gl|Período Heian|he|תקופת הייאן|hi|हेआन काल|hr|Heian (razdoblje)|hu|Heian-kor|hy|Հեիան ժամանակաշրջան|id|Zaman Heian|it|Periodo Heian|ja|平安時代|ka|ჰეიანის პერიოდი|ko|헤이안 시대|la|Aevum Heian|lt|Hejano laikotarpis|mn|Хэйан|mr|हियन कालावधी|ms|Zaman Heian|my|ဟဲအိအန်ခေတ်|nl|Heianperiode|nn|Heian|no|Heian-perioden|oc|Epòca d'Heian|pl|Heian|ps|هېيان دوره|pt|Período Heian|ro|Perioada Heian|ru|Период Хэйан|sh|Heianski period|simple|Heian period|sk|Obdobie Heian|sl|Obdobje Heian|sq|Periudha Heian|sr|Хеиан период|sv|Heian|ta|ஹையன் காலகட்டம்|th|ยุคเฮอัง|tl|Panahong Heian|tr|Heian Dönemi|uk|Період Хейан|vi|Thời kỳ Heian|war|Panahon Heian|wuu|平安时代|zh|平安时代|zh_classical|平安朝|zh_min_nan|Heian sî-tāi|zh_yue|平安時代|qid=Q193292|lt=Heian period}} describes Shinbetsu alongside ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|fr|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|ko|황별|qid=Q11581000}}'' and ''{{ill|Shoban|ja|諸蕃|ko|제번|zh_min_nan|Chu-hoan|qid=Q11632144}}'', identifying the descendants of ''{{ill|Amatsukami|fr|Amatsukami|it|Amatsukami|mni|ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|simple|Amatsukami|zh|天津神|qid=Q60994492}}'' and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|fr|Kunitsukami|it|Kunitsukami|ja|国津神|mni|ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|simple|Kunitsukami|zh|國津神|qid=Q60995523}}'' as "Shinbetsu" ("天神地祇之冑、謂之神別"). Furthermore, Shinbetsu is categorized into ''{{ill|Posterity of Heaven|ja|天孫|ko|천손|qid=Q108278353}}'', ''{{ill|Amatsukami|fr|Amatsukami|it|Amatsukami|mni|ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|simple|Amatsukami|zh|天津神|qid=Q60994492}}'', and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|fr|Kunitsukami|it|Kunitsukami|ja|国津神|mni|ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|simple|Kunitsukami|zh|國津神|qid=Q60995523}}'', with Tenson accounting for 109, Amatsukami for 265, and Kunitsukami for 30 entries. These classifications are thought to have ancient origins, as inferred from the concentration of ''{{ill|Omi (title)|be|Омі (тытул)|ff|Omi (title)|fr|Omi (titre de noblesse)|it|Omi|ja|臣|pt|Omi (título)|ru|Оми (титул)|simple|Omi (title)|uk|Омі (титул)|uz|Omi|zh|臣 (姓)|qid=Q2574718|lt=Omi}}'' titles among ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|fr|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|ko|황별|qid=Q11581000}}'' clans and ''{{ill|Muraji|es|Muraji|ff|Muraji|fr|Muraji|it|Muraji|ja|連|ko|무라지|nl|Muraji|pt|Muraji|ru|Мурадзи|uk|Мурадзі|qid=Q2735611|lt=Muraji}}'' titles among Shinbetsu clans under the pre-[[Ritsuryō system]].

The ancestral deity of a shinbetsu clan is their {{ill|Oyagami|fr|Oyagami|it|Oyagami|ja|祖神|simple|Oyagami|qid=Q85882782|lt=oyagami}} and will also be an {{ill|Ujigami|de|Ujigami|es|Ujigami|fa|اوجی‌گامی|fr|Ujigami|ja|氏神|ko|씨신|mni|ꯎꯖꯤꯒꯃꯤ|pl|Ujigami|ro|Ujigami|simple|Ujigami|te|ఉజిగామి|uk|Удзіґамі|zh|氏神|qid=Q767655|lt=ujigami}} although some clans may have other Ujigami such as the '''{{ill|Fujiwara clan|ar|فوجيوارا (عشيرة)|be|Фудзівара (род)|br|Klann Fujiwara|ca|Clan Fujiwara|cs|Fudžiwara|de|Fujiwara (Familie)|el|Αδελφότητα Φούτζιγουαρα|es|Clan Fujiwara|eu|Fujiwara klana|fa|خاندان فوجیوارا|fi|Fujiwara-klaani|fr|Clan Fujiwara|he|בית פוג'יווארה|hr|Fujiwara (klan)|hu|Fudzsivara család|id|Klan Fujiwara|it|Clan Fujiwara|ja|藤原氏|ko|후지와라씨|la|Domus Fujiwara|ms|Suku Fujiwara|nl|Fujiwara (familie)|pl|Fujiwara (ród)|pt|Clã Fujiwara|ru|Фудзивара (род)|sh|Fujiwara (klan)|sk|Fudžiwara|sr|Фуџивара клан|sv|Fujiwara|ta|புஜிவாரா குலம்|th|ตระกูลฟูจิวาระ|tr|Fujiwara boyu|uk|Рід Фудзівара|vi|Gia tộc Fujiwara|zh|藤原氏|zh_classical|藤原氏|zh_min_nan|Fujiwara--sī|qid=Q641628|lt=Fujiwara clan}}''' whose three Oyagami are {{ill|Ame-no-Koyane|fr|Ama-no-Koyane-no-mikoto|it|Ame-no-Koyane|ja|天児屋命|mni|ꯑꯃꯦ-ꯅꯣ-ꯀꯣꯌꯅꯦ|pt|Ame-no-Koyane|ru|Амэ-но коянэ-но микото|simple|Ame-no-Koyane|zh|天兒屋命|qid=Q2564508|lt=Ame-no-Koyane}}, {{ill|Himegami|fr|Himégami|ja|比売神|zh|比賣神|qid=Q22070227|lt=Himegami}} and {{ill|Ame-no-Oshikumone|fr|Ame-no-Oshikumone|ja|天押雲根命|simple|Ame-no-Oshikumone|qid=Q91088537}}, however the two are worshipped alongside two non-ancestral Ujigami: [[Takemikazuchi]]-o, and [[Futsunushi]]. The five are merged together into the composite deity {{ill|Kasuga-no-Kami|fr|Kasuga no Kami|ja|春日神|simple|Kasuga-no-Kami|zh|春日神|qid=Q11088805}} worshipped at [[Kasuga-taisha]] and many other Kasuga shrines nationwide.
